blocks.text: We welcome both experienced RNs and new graduates ready to launch their careers
LPN Roles Available in almost Every Province
Benefits of Working With Goodwill Staffing

blocks.html: Competitive bilingual pay rates. Travel, housing, and per diem coverage. Interprovincial licensing support (CLPNs, SALPN, CLPNNL, etc.). Bilingual placement opportunities available. 24/7 recruiter access and onboarding help. Over 1,100 placements completed in 2024.

items.question: Do I need hospital experience to apply?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We place LPNs in long-term care, clinics, group homes, and public health roles in addition to hospitals.

items.question: How quickly can I get placed?
items.answer: Most placements are made within 24–72 hours of credentialing.

items.question: Do you offer full-time and part-time roles?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose flexible scheduling options that suit your lifestyle.

items.question: Can I request travel or local roles only?
items.answer: Yes. We offer both local and travel placements tailored to your location and availability.

items.question: Are bilingual LPNs in demand?
items.answer: Very much so. We have dedicated roles for French/English-speaking LPNs in several provinces.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing connects licensed practical nurses with fulfilling healthcare roles across Canada. From LTCs to clinics to remote hospitals, we offer housing, travel, licensing help, and flexible contract or permanent opportunities.

blocks.text: Apply Now to Find a Travel Nursing Role That Fits

blocks.html: Let’s turn your skills into impact. Whether you're ready for your first contract or your fifteenth, we're here to support your journey. We respond to all qualified applicants within 1 business day.
